items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: You know Charlie Parker didn’t call it that, but it’s exactly the same thing.

ctx.x: and escape tones, which are known as echappées, and upper neighbors and lower neighbors, and grupettos and all that. In jazz it’s the same thing. You know Charlie Parker didn’t call it that, but it’s exactly the same thing.
Yeah. We call it after he played it.
